title: Jr Mod deny, go into more detail?

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hey,

1) Weak communication: The Senior Staff did not feel you went about providing your ideas and claims in a mature, respectful fashion. A lot of times, you would come off as stubborn or even disrespectful.

2) Immaturity: You admitted yourself in the Discord you were immature, but it was mainly your behavior in Discord channels that didn't shine you in too bright of a light. 

3) Poor handling of situations: There were a few situations that went into this, but one of them was your handling of your leaving-the-staff-team thread. You created a thread with a misleading title, and when approached to change the name of the thread, instead of complying, you went into a public Discord channel and made a comment claiming that two staff members pressured you into leaving. You then returned a few days after.

We look forward to seeing you improve your behavior and perhaps apply again next time applications come around. Thank you.
